svg.title: S for Social Media Design
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. The original black S has speech-bubble shapes, animated typing dots, a message, and a heart notification. It moves left as the Social Media Design heading and examples of post, story, and carousel designs appear.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop. Letter S, heart and dot traced from 19_S_social_media.png. All graphics, animation and typography are embedded; no external assets.

g.text: DESIGNED TO BE SEEN. MADE TO CONNECT.
